about.description: I'm a robotics and embedded engineer who turns ideas into working devices, from the circuit board to the code that runs on it. Over the past 5+ years I've delivered 50+ projects for clients worldwide, including system on module carrier boards, robot controllers and IoT devices.

description: Turn client requirements into complete hardware and firmware solutions for companies worldwide, from first schematic to production-ready design files.

Design multi-layer PCBs (up to 6 layers) in KiCad and Altium, including a system on module carrier board, a wearable location tracker with Wi-Fi, BLE, 4G LTE and GNSS, and a buck-boost switching regulator.
Develop C/C++ firmware for microcontrollers, covering BLDC motor control (FOC), IMU sensor fusion, energy monitoring and connected IoT devices.
Build ROS/ROS2 solutions for robot navigation, simulation and manipulation.
Test prototypes on the bench with oscilloscopes and logic analyzers, and deliver manufacturing documentation with every design.
Designed and validated multi-layer ESP32 PCBs, covering schematic review, signal integrity checks and system-level debugging.
Wrote low-level C firmware for ESP32 with multi-sensor integration and power management for battery-powered operation.
Integrated boards into finished products, including assembly, 3D-printed enclosures, wiring harnesses and power distribution.
Delivered full manufacturing packages (BOM, CPL, Gerber, assembly drawings) and test procedures, refining each design for reliability and manufacturability.
Developed and tested autonomous indoor navigation robots using the Slamware SDK for localization and mapping.
Designed robot structures in SolidWorks and built prototypes with CNC machining and 3D printing.
Integrated and validated complete robot systems across mechanical, electrical and software.
